metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
units.rightText: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

units.leftText: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
units.rightText: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

units.leftText: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
units.rightText: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

units.leftText: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
units.rightText: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
leftNotes: 1:4 LXX; Hebrew does not include The sons of Noah:; see Genesis 5:32|GEN 5:32*.

units.leftText: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
units.rightText: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

units.leftText: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
units.rightText: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
leftNotes: 1:6 Many Hebrew manuscripts and Vulgate (see also LXX and Genesis 10:3|GEN 10:3*); most Hebrew manuscripts Diphath

units.leftText: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
units.rightText: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

units.leftText: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
units.rightText: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

units.leftText: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
units.rightText: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
leftNotes: 1:9 Sabta is a variant of Sabtah; see Genesis 10:7|GEN 10:7*.

units.leftText: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
units.rightText: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
leftNotes: 1:10 Or who established himself as a mighty warrior

units.leftText: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
units.rightText: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

units.leftText: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
units.rightText: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whence came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.
leftNotes: 1:12 Some translators adjust the Hebrew word order to the Casluhites, and the Caphtorites (from whom the Philistines came); see also Jeremiah 47:4|JER 47:4* and Amos 9:7.

units.leftText: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
units.rightText: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,
leftNotes: 1:13 Or of the Sidonians, the foremost
1:13 Hebrew and of Heth

units.leftText: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
units.rightText: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

units.leftText: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
units.rightText: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

units.leftText: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
units.rightText: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

units.leftText: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
units.rightText: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
leftNotes: 1:17 One Hebrew manuscript and some LXX manuscripts (see also Genesis 10:23|GEN 10:23*); most Hebrew manuscripts do not include The sons of Aram.
1:17 Meshech is a variant of Mash; see Genesis 10:23|GEN 10:23*.

units.leftText: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
units.rightText: And Arpachshad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

units.leftText: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
units.rightText: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
leftNotes: 1:19 Peleg means division.

units.leftText: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
units.rightText: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

units.leftText: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
units.rightText: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

units.leftText: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
units.rightText: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
leftNotes: 1:22 LXX and Syriac (see also Genesis 10:28|GEN 10:28*); Hebrew Ebal

units.leftText: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
units.rightText: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

units.leftText: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
units.rightText: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
leftNotes: 1:24 Literally Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah; some LXX manuscripts Shem, Arphaxad, Cainan, Shelah; see also Genesis 10:24|GEN 10:24* LXX and Luke 3:35–36.

units.leftText: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
units.rightText: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

units.leftText: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
units.rightText: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

units.leftText: and Abram (that is, Abraham). The Descendants of Abraham (Genesis 25:12–18|GEN 25:12-18*)
units.rightText: Abram (the same is Abraham).

units.leftText: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
units.rightText: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.

units.leftText: These are their genealogies:
units.rightText: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

units.leftText: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
units.rightText: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

units.leftText: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
units.rightText: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

units.leftText: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
units.rightText: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.

units.leftText: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
units.rightText: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

units.leftText: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel. The Descendants of Esau (Genesis 36:1–19|GEN 36:1-19*)
units.rightText: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.

units.leftText: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
units.rightText: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

units.leftText: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
units.rightText: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
leftNotes: 1:36 Many Hebrew manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, and Syriac (see also Genesis 36:11|GEN 36:11*); most Hebrew manuscripts Zephi

units.leftText: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The Descendants of Seir (Genesis 36:20–30|GEN 36:20-30*)
units.rightText: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

units.leftText: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
units.rightText: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

units.leftText: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
units.rightText: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
leftNotes: 1:39 Homam is a variant of Hemam; see Genesis 36:22|GEN 36:22*.

units.leftText: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
units.rightText: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
leftNotes: 1:40 LXX (see also Genesis 36:23|GEN 36:23*); Hebrew Alian
1:40 LXX (see also Genesis 36:23|GEN 36:23*); Hebrew Shephi

units.leftText: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
units.rightText: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
leftNotes: 1:41 Hebrew sons
1:41 LXX (see also Genesis 36:26|GEN 36:26*); Hebrew Hamran

units.leftText: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran. The Kings of Edom (Genesis 36:31–43|GEN 36:31-43*)
units.rightText: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
leftNotes: 1:42 LXX (see also Genesis 36:27|GEN 36:27*); Hebrew Jaakan

units.leftText: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
units.rightText: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
leftNotes: 1:43 Or before an Israelite king ruled over them

units.leftText: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
units.rightText: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

units.leftText: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
units.rightText: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

units.leftText: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
units.rightText: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.

units.leftText: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
units.rightText: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

units.leftText: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
units.rightText: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
leftNotes: 1:48 Hebrew the River

units.leftText: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
units.rightText: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

units.leftText: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
units.rightText: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
leftNotes: 1:50 Many MT manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, Vulgate, and Syriac (see also Genesis 36:39|GEN 36:39*); most MT manuscripts Pai

units.leftText: Then Hadad died.
units.rightText: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

units.leftText: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
units.rightText: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

units.leftText: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
units.rightText: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

units.leftText: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
units.rightText: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

units.leftText: These were the sons of Israel:
units.rightText: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

units.leftText: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
units.rightText: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

units.leftText: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
units.rightText: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.

units.leftText: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
units.rightText: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bare him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

units.leftText: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
units.rightText: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.

units.leftText: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara — five in all.
units.rightText: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
leftNotes: 2:6 Zimri is a variant of Zabdi; see Joshua 7:1|JOS 7:1*.
2:6 Most Hebrew manuscripts; many Hebrew manuscripts, some LXX manuscripts, and Syriac (see also 1 Kings 4:31|1KI 4:31*) Darda

units.leftText: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
units.rightText: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
leftNotes: 2:7 Hebrew sons
2:7 Achar means troubler; also called Achan in Joshua 7 and Joshua 22.

units.leftText: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
units.rightText: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.

units.leftText: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
units.rightText: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
leftNotes: 2:9 Hebrew Chelubai, a variant of Caleb; see verse 18.

units.leftText: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
units.rightText: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

units.leftText: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
units.rightText: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
leftNotes: 2:11 LXX (see also Ruth 4:20–21|RUT 4:20-21*); Hebrew Salma; twice in this verse

units.leftText: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
units.rightText: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse;

units.leftText: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
units.rightText: and Jesse begat his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
leftNotes: 2:13 Shimea is a variant of Shammah, Shimeah, and Shimei; see 1 Samuel 16:9|1SA 16:9*, 2 Samuel 13:3, and 2 Samuel 21:21.

units.leftText: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,
units.rightText: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

units.leftText: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
units.rightText: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;

units.leftText: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
units.rightText: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

units.leftText: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
units.rightText: And Abigail bare Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
leftNotes: 2:17 Jether is a variant of Ithra; see 2 Samuel 17:25|2SA 17:25*.

units.leftText: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
units.rightText: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

units.leftText: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
units.rightText: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bare him Hur.
leftNotes: 2:19 Ephrath is a variant of Ephrathah; see verse 50.

units.leftText: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
units.rightText: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.

units.leftText: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
units.rightText: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took to wife when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

units.leftText: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
units.rightText: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

units.leftText: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
units.rightText: And Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
leftNotes: 2:23 Or the villages of Jair

units.leftText: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
units.rightText: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
leftNotes: 2:24 Or After Hezron died, Caleb had relations with Ephrathah, the wife of Hezron his father, and she bore; see also LXX.
2:24 Or the founder; also in verses 42, 45, 49, and possibly elsewhere

units.leftText: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
units.rightText: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.

units.leftText: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
units.rightText: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

units.leftText: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
units.rightText: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

units.leftText: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai:
units.rightText: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.

units.leftText: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
units.rightText: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

units.leftText: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
units.rightText: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

units.leftText: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
units.rightText: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
leftNotes: 2:31 Hebrew sons; three times in this verse

units.leftText: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
units.rightText: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

units.leftText: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
units.rightText: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

units.leftText: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
units.rightText: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

units.leftText: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
units.rightText: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

units.leftText: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
units.rightText: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

units.leftText: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
units.rightText: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

units.leftText: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
units.rightText: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

units.leftText: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
units.rightText: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

units.leftText: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
units.rightText: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,

units.leftText: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
units.rightText: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

units.leftText: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
units.rightText: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his first-born, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
leftNotes: 2:42 Hebrew; LXX Mareshah

units.leftText: The sons of Hebron:
units.rightText: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

units.leftText: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
units.rightText: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begat Shammai.

units.leftText: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
units.rightText: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

units.leftText: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
units.rightText: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.

units.leftText: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
units.rightText: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jothan, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

units.leftText: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
units.rightText: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber and Tirhanah.

units.leftText: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
units.rightText: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

units.leftText: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:
units.rightText: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
leftNotes: 2:50 LXX and Vulgate; Hebrew son
2:50 Ephrathah is a variant of Ephrath; see verse 19.

units.leftText: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
units.rightText: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

units.leftText: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:
units.rightText: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

units.leftText: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim— the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
units.rightText: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

units.leftText: The descendants of Salma:
units.rightText: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

units.leftText: and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez— the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
units.rightText: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
leftNotes: 2:55 Or of the Sopherites
2:55 Or the father of Beth-rekab or the founder of the house of Rechab

units.leftText: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
units.rightText: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

units.leftText: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
units.rightText: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

units.leftText: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
units.rightText: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

units.leftText: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months.
units.rightText: six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years;

units.leftText: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
units.rightText: and these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
leftNotes: 3:5 Shimea is a variant of Shammua; see 2 Samuel 5:14|2SA 5:14* and 1 Chronicles 14:4.
3:5 One Hebrew manuscript and Vulgate (see also LXX and 2 Samuel 11:3|2SA 11:3*); most Hebrew manuscripts Bath-shua
3:5 Ammiel is a variant of Eliam; see 2 Samuel 11:3|2SA 11:3*.

units.leftText: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
units.rightText: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
leftNotes: 3:6 Hebrew does not include David’s other sons were.
3:6 Two Hebrew manuscripts (see also 2 Samuel 5:15|2SA 5:15* and 1 Chronicles 14:5); most Hebrew manuscripts Elishama

units.leftText: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
units.rightText: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

units.leftText: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet— nine in all.
units.rightText: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

units.leftText: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister. The Descendants of Solomon
units.rightText: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

units.leftText: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam:
units.rightText: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

units.leftText: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
units.rightText: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
leftNotes: 3:11 Joram is a variant spelling of Jehoram.

units.leftText: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
units.rightText: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
leftNotes: 3:12 Azariah is also called Uzziah; see 2 Chronicles 26:1|2CH 26:1*.

units.leftText: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
units.rightText: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

units.leftText: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
units.rightText: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

units.leftText: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
units.rightText: And the sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
leftNotes: 3:15 Shallum is another name for Jehoahaz.

units.leftText: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah. The Royal Line After the Exile
units.rightText: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
leftNotes: 3:16 Jeconiah is a variant of Jehoiachin; also in verse 17; see 2 Kings 24:6|2KI 24:6*.

units.leftText: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:
units.rightText: And the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

units.leftText: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
units.rightText: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

units.leftText: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel:
units.rightText: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

units.leftText: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
units.rightText: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

units.leftText: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
units.rightText: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

units.leftText: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
units.rightText: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

units.leftText: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam— three in all.
units.rightText: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

units.leftText: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani— seven in all.
units.rightText: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

units.leftText: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
units.rightText: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

units.leftText: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
units.rightText: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

units.leftText: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
units.rightText: And these were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
leftNotes: 4:3 LXX (see also Vulgate); Hebrew These were of the father

units.leftText: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
units.rightText: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.
leftNotes: 4:4 Or the founder; also in verses 5, 12, 14, 17, 18, and possibly elsewhere

units.leftText: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
units.rightText: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

units.leftText: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
units.rightText: And Naarah bare him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

units.leftText: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
units.rightText: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
leftNotes: 4:7 Alternate MT reading; the other alternate (see also Vulgate) reads Izhar.

units.leftText: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum. The Prayer of Jabez
units.rightText: And Hakkoz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

units.leftText: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
units.rightText: And Jabez was more honorable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
leftNotes: 4:9 Jabez sounds like the Hebrew for pain or distress.

units.leftText: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez. More Descendants of Judah
units.rightText: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it be not to my sorrow! And God granted him that which he requested.

units.leftText: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
units.rightText: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begat Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

units.leftText: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
units.rightText: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

units.leftText: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
units.rightText: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
leftNotes: 4:13 Vulgate and some LXX; Hebrew does not include and Meonothai.

units.leftText: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
units.rightText: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.
leftNotes: 4:14 Literally Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen. The Hebrew Ge-harashim means valley of craftsmen.

units.leftText: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
units.rightText: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.
leftNotes: 4:15 Hebrew sons

units.leftText: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
units.rightText: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

units.leftText: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.
units.rightText: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

units.leftText: These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
units.rightText: And his wife the Jewess bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
leftNotes: 4:18 This statement is at the end of verse 18 in the Hebrew.
4:18 Or Judahite

units.leftText: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
units.rightText: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
leftNotes: 4:19 Or were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite

units.leftText: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
units.rightText: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

units.leftText: The sons of Shelah son of Judah:
units.rightText: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

units.leftText: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
units.rightText: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records are ancient.

units.leftText: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king. The Descendants of Simeon
units.rightText: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

units.leftText: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
units.rightText: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
leftNotes: 4:24 Zerah is a variant of Zohar; see Genesis 46:10|GEN 46:10* and Exodus 6:15.

units.leftText: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
units.rightText: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

units.leftText: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
units.rightText: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

units.leftText: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
units.rightText: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply like to the children of Judah.

units.leftText: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
units.rightText: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

units.leftText: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
units.rightText: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

units.leftText: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
units.rightText: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

units.leftText: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
units.rightText: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

units.leftText: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan— five towns—
units.rightText: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

units.leftText: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
units.rightText: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
leftNotes: 4:33 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts (see also Joshua 19:8|JOS 19:8*) Baalath

units.leftText: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
units.rightText: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

units.leftText: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
units.rightText: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

units.leftText: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
units.rightText: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

units.leftText: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
units.rightText: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

units.leftText: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
units.rightText: these mentioned by name were princes in their families: and their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

units.leftText: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
units.rightText: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

units.leftText: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
units.rightText: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.

units.leftText: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings as well as the Meunites who were there, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
units.rightText: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
leftNotes: 4:41 Forms of the Hebrew cherem refer to the giving over of things or persons to the LORD, either by destroying them or by giving them as an offering.

units.leftText: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
units.rightText: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

units.leftText: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
units.rightText: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and have dwelt there unto this day.

units.leftText: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
units.rightText: And the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel (for he was the first-born; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

units.leftText: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
units.rightText: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s),

units.leftText: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
units.rightText: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

units.leftText: The descendants of Joel:
units.rightText: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

units.leftText: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
units.rightText: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

units.leftText: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile.
units.rightText: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
leftNotes: 5:6 Hebrew Tilgath-pilneser, a variant spelling of Tiglath-pileser; also in verse 26

units.leftText: His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy:
units.rightText: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

units.leftText: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
units.rightText: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

units.leftText: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
units.rightText: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

units.leftText: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
units.rightText: And in the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

units.leftText: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
units.rightText: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salecah:

units.leftText: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
units.rightText: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

units.leftText: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber— seven in all.
units.rightText: And their brethren of their fathers’ houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.

units.leftText: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
units.rightText: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

units.leftText: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
units.rightText: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
units.rightText: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.

units.leftText: All of them were recorded in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
units.rightText: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

units.leftText: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors— valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
units.rightText: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were forty and four thousand seven hundred and threescore, that were able to go forth to war.

units.leftText: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
units.rightText: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

units.leftText: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
units.rightText: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated of them, because they put their trust in him.

units.leftText: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites— 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
units.rightText: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand.

units.leftText: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile. The Half-Tribe of Manasseh
units.rightText: For there fell many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.

units.leftText: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
units.rightText: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon.
leftNotes: 5:23 Literally from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and Mount Hermon.

units.leftText: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel.
units.rightText: And these were the heads of their fathers’ houses: even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
units.rightText: And they trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

units.leftText: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
units.rightText: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.

units.leftText: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
units.rightText: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

units.leftText: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
units.rightText: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

units.leftText: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
units.rightText: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

units.leftText: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
units.rightText: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

units.leftText: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
units.rightText: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

units.leftText: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
units.rightText: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

units.leftText: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
units.rightText: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

units.leftText: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
units.rightText: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

units.leftText: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
units.rightText: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

units.leftText: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
units.rightText: and Johanan begat Azariah (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem),

units.leftText: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
units.rightText: and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

units.leftText: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,
units.rightText: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

units.leftText: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
units.rightText: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

units.leftText: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
units.rightText: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak;
leftNotes: 6:14 Jehozadak is a variant of Jozadak; also in verse 15; see Ezra 3:2|EZR 3:2*.

units.leftText: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
units.rightText: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when Jehovah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

units.leftText: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
units.rightText: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
leftNotes: 6:16 Gershom is a variant of Gershon; similarly in verses 17, 20, 43, 62, and 71; see verse 1.

units.leftText: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
units.rightText: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

units.leftText: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
units.rightText: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

units.leftText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
units.rightText: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: Of Gershom:
units.rightText: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

units.leftText: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
units.rightText: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.

units.leftText: The descendants of Kohath:
units.rightText: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

units.leftText: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
units.rightText: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
leftNotes: 6:23 Ebiasaph is a variant of Abiasaph; also in verse 37; see Exodus 6:24|EXO 6:24*.

units.leftText: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
units.rightText: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

units.leftText: The descendants of Elkanah:
units.rightText: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.

units.leftText: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
units.rightText: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
leftNotes: 6:26 Some Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac; most Hebrew manuscripts Elkanah. The sons of Elkanah:

units.leftText: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
units.rightText: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
leftNotes: 6:27 Eliab is also called Eliel; see verse 34. Both of these are other names for Elihu; see 1 Samuel 1:1|1SA 1:1*.
6:27 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts include and Samuel his son; see verses 33–34 and 1 Samuel 1:19–20|1SA 1:19-20*.

units.leftText: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
units.rightText: And the sons of Samuel: the first-born, Joel, and the second Abijah.
leftNotes: 6:28 See Syriac and some LXX manuscripts (also verse 33 and 1 Samuel 8:2|1SA 8:2*); Hebrew The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni, then Abiah.

units.leftText: The descendants of Merari:
units.rightText: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

units.leftText: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son. The Temple Musicians
units.rightText: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

units.leftText: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
units.rightText: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Jehovah, after that the ark had rest.

units.leftText: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
units.rightText: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.

units.leftText: These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites:
units.rightText: And these are they that waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

units.leftText: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
units.rightText: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
leftNotes: 6:34 Eliel is also called Eliab; see verse 27. Both of these are other names for Elihu; see 1 Samuel 1:1|1SA 1:1*.

units.leftText: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
units.rightText: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

units.leftText: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
units.rightText: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

units.leftText: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
units.rightText: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

units.leftText: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
units.rightText: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

units.leftText: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand:
units.rightText: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

units.leftText: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
units.rightText: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
leftNotes: 6:40 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts, one LXX manuscript, and Syriac Maaseiah

units.leftText: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
units.rightText: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

units.leftText: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
units.rightText: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

units.leftText: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
units.rightText: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

units.leftText: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari:
units.rightText: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

units.leftText: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
units.rightText: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

units.leftText: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
units.rightText: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

units.leftText: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi. The Descendants of Aaron
units.rightText: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

units.leftText: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
units.rightText: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

units.leftText: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
units.rightText: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt-offering, and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
leftNotes: 6:49 Or the Holy of Holies

units.leftText: These were the descendants of Aaron:
units.rightText: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

units.leftText: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
units.rightText: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

units.leftText: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
units.rightText: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

units.leftText: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son. Territories for the Levites (Numbers 35:1–8|NUM 35:1-8*; Joshua 21:1–45|JOS 21:1-45*)
units.rightText: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

units.leftText: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
units.rightText: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

units.leftText: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
units.rightText: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it;

units.leftText: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
units.rightText: but the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

units.leftText: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
units.rightText: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
leftNotes: 6:57 As in the parallel text at Joshua 21:13|JOS 21:13*; Hebrew were given the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah

units.leftText: Hilen, Debir,
units.rightText: and Hilen with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
leftNotes: 6:58 Some Hebrew manuscripts; MT Hilez; parallel text at Joshua 21:15|JOS 21:15* Holon

units.leftText: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with its suburbs;
leftNotes: 6:59 Ashan is a variant of Ain; see Joshua 21:16|JOS 21:16*.
6:59 Syriac and the parallel text at Joshua 21:16|JOS 21:16*; MT does not include Juttah,

units.leftText: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
units.rightText: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its suburbs, and Allemeth with its suburbs, and Anathoth with its suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
leftNotes: 6:60 LXX, Syriac, and parallel text at Joshua 21:17|JOS 21:17*; MT does not include Gibeon,

units.leftText: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
units.rightText: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

units.leftText: The Gershomites , according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
units.rightText: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
leftNotes: 6:62 Gershomites is a variant of Gershonites; also in verse 71; see 1 Chronicles 23:7|1CH 23:7*.

units.leftText: The Merarites, according to their clans, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
units.rightText: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

units.leftText: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
units.rightText: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their suburbs.

units.leftText: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
units.rightText: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

units.leftText: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
units.rightText: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

units.leftText: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
units.rightText: And they gave unto them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,
leftNotes: 6:67 As in the parallel text at Joshua 21:21|JOS 21:21*; Hebrew They were given the cities of refuge: Shechem

units.leftText: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,
units.rightText: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beth-horon with its suburbs,

units.leftText: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Aijalon with its suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with its suburbs;

units.leftText: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of the clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

units.leftText: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: Unto the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, and Ashtaroth with its suburbs;

units.leftText: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
units.rightText: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,

units.leftText: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Ramoth with its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs;

units.leftText: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
units.rightText: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its suburbs, and Abdon with its suburbs,

units.leftText: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Hukok with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs;

units.leftText: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, and Hammon with its suburbs, and Kiriathaim with its suburbs.

units.leftText: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: Unto the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its suburbs, Tabor with its suburbs;
leftNotes: 6:77 LXX (they were given) Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono, and Tabor; see Joshua 21:34|JOS 21:34*.

units.leftText: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
units.rightText: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,
leftNotes: 6:78 Jahzah is a variant of Jahaz; see Numbers 21:23|NUM 21:23*.

units.leftText: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;

units.leftText: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
units.rightText: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,

units.leftText: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
units.rightText: and Heshbon with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.

units.leftText: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron— four in all.
units.rightText: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
leftNotes: 7:1 Puah is a variant of Puvah; see Genesis 46:13|GEN 46:13* and Numbers 26:23.

units.leftText: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
units.rightText: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, to wit, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

units.leftText: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah:
units.rightText: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
leftNotes: 7:3 Hebrew sons; also in verses 10 and 17

units.leftText: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
units.rightText: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

units.leftText: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies. The Descendants of Benjamin
units.rightText: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.

units.leftText: The three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
units.rightText: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

units.leftText: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families— five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
units.rightText: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

units.leftText: The sons of Becher:
units.rightText: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

units.leftText: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families— 20,200 mighty men of valor.
units.rightText: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand and two hundred.

units.leftText: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan:
units.rightText: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

units.leftText: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
units.rightText: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.

units.leftText: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher. The Descendants of Naphtali
units.rightText: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the sons of Aher.

units.leftText: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum — the descendants of Bilhah. The Descendants of Manasseh
units.rightText: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
leftNotes: 7:13 Jahziel is a variant of Jahzeel; see Genesis 46:24|GEN 46:24*.
7:13 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew and LXX manuscripts Shillem; see Genesis 46:24|GEN 46:24* and Numbers 26:49.

units.leftText: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel through his Aramean concubine. She also gave birth to Machir the father of Gilead.
units.rightText: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bare; she bare Machir the father of Gilead.

units.leftText: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
units.rightText: And Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

units.leftText: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
units.rightText: And Maacah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

units.leftText: The son of Ulam: Bedan.
units.rightText: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

units.leftText: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
units.rightText: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.

units.leftText: And these were the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
units.rightText: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

units.leftText: The descendants of Ephraim:
units.rightText: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,

units.leftText: Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
units.rightText: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

units.leftText: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
units.rightText: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

units.leftText: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
units.rightText: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
leftNotes: 7:23 Beriah sounds like the Hebrew for tragedy or disaster.

units.leftText: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
units.rightText: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.

units.leftText: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
units.rightText: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
leftNotes: 7:25 Some LXX manuscripts; Hebrew does not include his son.

units.leftText: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
units.rightText: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

units.leftText: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
units.rightText: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
leftNotes: 7:27 Or Non

units.leftText: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
units.rightText: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Azzah and the towns thereof;
leftNotes: 7:28 Ayyah is another name for Gaza; see also LXX.

units.leftText: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns. The Descendants of Asher
units.rightText: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
leftNotes: 7:29 Beth-shean is a variant of Beth-shan; see 1 Samuel 31:10|1SA 31:10* and 2 Samuel 21:12.

units.leftText: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
units.rightText: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

units.leftText: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
units.rightText: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

units.leftText: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
units.rightText: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

units.leftText: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
units.rightText: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

units.leftText: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
units.rightText: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
leftNotes: 7:34 Or The sons of his brother Shemer: Rohgah; note that Shemer is a variant of Shomer; see verse 32.

units.leftText: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
units.rightText: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
leftNotes: 7:35 Helem is possibly another name for Hotham; see verse 32.

units.leftText: The sons of Zophah:
units.rightText: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

units.leftText: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
units.rightText: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
leftNotes: 7:37 Ithran is possibly a variant of Jether; see verse 38.

units.leftText: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
units.rightText: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.

units.leftText: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
units.rightText: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.

units.leftText: All these were the descendants of Asher — heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
units.rightText: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.

units.leftText: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
units.rightText: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

units.leftText: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
units.rightText: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

units.leftText: The sons of Bela:
units.rightText: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

units.leftText: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
units.rightText: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

units.leftText: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
units.rightText: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

units.leftText: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
units.rightText: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:

units.leftText: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
units.rightText: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive; and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.
leftNotes: 8:7 Or and Gera, that is Heglam, who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

units.leftText: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
units.rightText: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

units.leftText: His sons by his wife Hodesh:
units.rightText: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,

units.leftText: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
units.rightText: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ houses.

units.leftText: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
units.rightText: And of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.

units.leftText: The sons of Elpaal:
units.rightText: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with the towns thereof;

units.leftText: and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
units.rightText: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

units.leftText: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
units.rightText: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

units.leftText: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
units.rightText: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

units.leftText: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
